answer: To secure the decentralized oasis of autonomous agents, we employ recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments coupled with sequential verifiable delay functions initialized by a yarrow-based beacon. By mandating staking collateral per agent identity, any attempt to clone an identity triggers slashing penalties that reduce the adversary's stake to an ember. This zero-knowledge architecture enforces a negative expected attack utility, guaranteeing a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation remains the only viable strategy.
